analysis.headline: Trump unveils AI self-policing accord; signed pledge misspells 'United States'
analysis.summary: Tech executives signed a voluntary AI safety accord, the Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities, agreeing to self-police their AI development; the signed document misspelled 'United States.' Outlets differ on scale, citing six signatories or dozens of firms, and in tone, from detailed reporting to skepticism about the pledge's impact.
